titulo: The Growing Crescent of Mars as NASA’s Psyche Mission Approaches
cuerpo: Description This composite of images taken by NASA’s Psyche mission shows the crescent of Mars grow as the spacecraft approached the planet for a gravity assist from May 2 to May 15, 2026.
